# Opero Docs

> Documentation for Opero product concepts, integrations, API tokens, and API workflows.

These docs describe public Opero concepts and the external Opero API. English is the primary index. Polish documentation is available under `https://kodasoft.pl/docs/pl`.

## Start Here

- [Welcome](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en): Overview of Opero docs and the recommended reading path.
- [Getting Started](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/getting-started): Find the API base URL, prepare an API token, and make a first request.

## API Essentials

- [API Overview](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api): Entry point for Opero API documentation.
- [Authentication](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/authentication): Use Opero API tokens with bearer authentication.
- [Language](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/language): Request localized API responses with the Accept-Language header.
- [OpenAPI](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/open-api): Use the current OpenAPI schema with API tools and client generators.

## Product Context

- [Opero](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/opero): Browse product documentation generated from public Opero documentation records.
- [Record Lists](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/opero/04-listy-rekordow/lista-rekordow): Record lists, list views, search, filtering, and export.
- [Automation](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/opero/07-automatyzacja/reguly-wprowadzenie): Automation rules, triggers, actions, notifications, and custom scripts.

## API Resource Guides

- [Contractors](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/companies/get-companies-companyid-contractors): Work with contractors, suppliers, customers, and other business partners.
- [Service Catalog](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/companies/get-companies-companyid-service-catalog-items): Manage reusable services, goods, and bundles.
- [Custom Modules](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/custom-modules/list-custom-modules): List and manage custom module definitions.
- [Custom Objects](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/custom-objects/list-custom-objects): Work with custom object schemas and records.
- [Rules](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/rules/introduction): Manage and run Opero automation rules.
- [View Layout Configuration](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/view-layout-configuration/overview): Build and publish View Layouts for Opero records and forms.
- [View Layout Runtime](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/view-layout-runtime/runtime): Resolve published View Layouts, load runtime data, and save records.
- [Files](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/companies/post-companies-companyid-files-attachments): Upload attachment files.
- [Entity Attachments](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/companies/post-companies-companyid-entity-attachments): Attach files to Opero records.
- [Entity Comments](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/en/api/companies/get-companies-companyid-entity-comments-entitytype-entityid): Read and manage record comments.

## Machine-Readable References

- [OpenAPI schema](https://opero.kodasoft.pl/api/swagger/v1/json): Current external API contract.
- [Sitemap](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/sitemap.xml): Complete public docs URL list.
- [Search index](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/static.json): Public structured search index with page titles, descriptions, and content excerpts.

## Optional

- [Polish docs](https://kodasoft.pl/docs/pl): Polish version of the documentation.
